offers_products.reason: Weis Markets operates supermarkets selling groceries, fresh foods, and private-label products, plus pharmacy and fuel.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from retail grocery sales; pharmacy services are a minor part of the business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Households shop at its supermarkets for groceries and household goods.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sales are almost entirely to individual shoppers in retail stores.

recurring_revenue.reason: Households repeatedly buy groceries weekly, so revenue comes from repeat purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Groceries are staples that shoppers keep buying in a recession.

big_ticket.reason: Grocery baskets are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for groceries and goods from a retail store network, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are households shopping at supermarkets.

asset_heavy.reason: It needs ongoing investment in supermarkets, distribution centers, a truck fleet, and fuel stations.
